item.title: Building destroyed in Grantham fire
item.description: Two fire crews from Grantham attended an outbuilding fire on Hill Avenue in Grantham, at about 1am this morning. It caused severe fire damage to a derelict outbuilding. Crews used a hose reel, 1 saw, a ladder and a thermal imaging camera to extinguished. The post Building destroyed in Grantham fire appeared first on Grantham Matters.
